description.value: Pizza64 is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 2010, with over 20 locations across British Columbia, known for making fresh dough and sauce at each individual location. The Surrey location sits in a commercial unit on 64 Avenue and offers a broad menu of specialty, signature, and gourmet pizzas alongside wings, pasta, and sides. Online ordering and a loyalty rewards program are available, making it a convenient refuelling stop on a longer ride.

The menu includes clearly vegetarian pizza options (Garden Fresh, Pesto Veggie).
